verdict: Pass within the reviewed scope. Independently inspected index.html, builder.md, checks.json, 375-light.png, 1280-dark.png and 375-light-200pct.png. In Chromium, focused navigation links and activated them with Enter through work, decisions and overview. Each transition exposes exactly one matching view, sets exactly one matching aria-current=page link, updates document.title and focuses the matching H1. Back from overview returns to decisions; Forward returns to overview, with matching content, current link and heading focus. Fresh pages loaded directly at #/overview, #/work and #/decisions show the correct view without moving initial focus from BODY. A fresh #/missing hash resolves to #/overview. An unknown hash entered after work resolves to overview, and Back returns directly to work without an extra correction entry. Inactive views' links and summaries have no rendered rectangles. Inspected long navigation labels in desktop, narrow and enlarged screenshots: labels wrap without truncation, navigation retains its ordering, and active state includes underline, weight and a leading rule. Independently doubled every rendered element's computed font size on fresh pages at 375px for all three routes; document scrollWidth remained 375px with a 32px body font. Supplied checks report no overflow, unlabeled controls, small targets or text-contrast failures in both themes, including 375px at 200%. No actionable fixture or shared-skill/token defect was verified. This review establishes Chromium browser behavior and the inspected renders, not native-platform or screen-reader certification.
